title: Mystic Sorceress Portal
description: A blonde woman in a black and blue corset with lace sleeves and a patterned bandana stands in the foreground, smiling at the viewer. Behind her a large glowing circular magical portal with runes floats in a cosmic nebula sky, with a framed portrait of the same woman resting on red velvet fabric surrounded by lit candles.
prompt: A beautiful blonde woman wearing a black leather corset with blue details, intricate black lace sleeves, and a black and white patterned bandana on her head stands smiling in a cosmic scene. A large glowing circular magical portal with floating runes and bright blue energy swirls in the starry nebula background. In the foreground, a golden framed portrait of the same woman sits on rich red velvet fabric surrounded by several lit candles, mystical atmosphere, highly detailed digital fantasy art.
